datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule throughout 2014 across Kenya. The classifications represent spatial assessments of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying drought hazards. Data were compiled into geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with temporal snapshots at January, April, July, and October 2014.
